jimmysparrow17: Yann Jimmysparrow stepped off the supply cart at S-F8 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Yann Jimmysparrow stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The parcel for Yann Jimmysparrow contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Machine-gun fire swept S-F8. Yann Jimmysparrow took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Otto Valiantlyval of the Concord (@valiantlyvaliancy).
lucas_davis1775: Day 5: Oskar Davis reached R-F23 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
rachelejosiah: Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia left an old father who runs the family shop alone behind in Port Abel and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he is superstitious about the number three.
Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0: At the depot, Wendel "Mole" Day had practised answering to his name. At S-F10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Wendel "Mole" Day, volunteer number 74, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Wendel "Mole" Day walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Wendel "Mole" Day opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Wendel "Mole" Day kept the tin.
yaboyslydude: Nobody asked Wendel Yaboyslydude why he came. Nobody in R-F19 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
A newspaper reached Wendel Yaboyslydude with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Dawn watch. Wendel Yaboyslydude put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Casimir "Spark" Dominickg, grazed.
zaboravljeninemanjic: They issued Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lucky button in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
First Wave. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a lucky button.
A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni mended a split glove with pale thread. The repair makes one finger look as though it has been promoted.

The patrol returned one at a time. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni held the entrance clear and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
